Spike: assess the value and feasibility of a shipment-sequence mechanism (a ship_sequence.jsonl manifest) that lets the Orchestrator declare and persist the logical execution order of shipments across a long-running series of shipments in dark factory mode (P-017). Evaluate: what the manifest records (ordered shipment IDs + dependency/rationale metadata); how the Orchestrator produces and consumes it during Stage->Ship routing; interaction with existing queue-view and item_deps dependency ordering and the shipment lifecycle; whether it duplicates or complements existing ordering surfaces; storage/schema/index implications (new file under .backlogit/ + optional SQLite projection); and dark-mode scope/visibility (DARK_MODE_SCOPE) events. Deliverable: findings artifact with a build / do-not-build / defer recommendation and optional backlog linkage. Refs: P-017 dark factory mode, orchestrator agent (.github/agents/_orchestrator.agent.md).
